status: Development comparison frozen before fetching this selection; not an unseen benchmark or accuracy score.

questions.question: Why do boats float?
questions.review: Displaced water weight balances vessel weight; do not claim water is denser than steel or conflate volume with weight.

questions.question: Can two computers share files over a local network without internet access?
questions.review: Yes with local connectivity and compatible sharing services; no mandatory same OS, internet or proprietary license.

questions.question: Compare mitosis and meiosis.
questions.review: Distinguish number of divisions, chromosome complement and variation; do not universally equate four products with four functional gametes.

questions.question: Why do Earth’s hemispheres have opposite seasons?
questions.review: Axial tilt and opposite illumination at the same time, not Earth-Sun distance; avoid hemisphere/month inversion.

questions.question: How does thermal insulation slow heat transfer?
questions.review: Resistance to heat flow rather than producing heat; retain distinctions between transfer mechanisms.

questions.question: Why does a DNS outage not necessarily stop file sharing on a local network?
questions.review: Distinguish name resolution from local transport; addressing and service configuration affect availability.

questions.question: How can sampling bias make a large survey misleading?
questions.review: Selection can distort representation; sample size alone does not remove systematic bias.

questions.question: Using only my saved sources, which roads near me are closed right now?
questions.review: Do not invent current conditions or cite timeless references as live information.

method: Same unchanged app pipeline/model and questions, current Biology+Travel vs current packs plus preview. Review original selected passages and generated claims separately. No competitor benchmark or answers used.
